AVX-512 ushort vector macros and load/store, add, and sub operations.

# Purpose
This header defines the AVX-512 `ushort` vector API for the `wwh_t` type, where each 16-bit lane holds one unsigned 16-bit integer. It provides basic constants such as `wwh_zero()` and `wwh_one()`, plus aligned and unaligned load and store helpers for moving data between memory and vector registers. It also defines arithmetic macros such as `wwh_add(x,y)` and `wwh_sub(x,y)` that map directly to AVX-512 integer instructions. The file is guarded so it can only be included through `fd_avx512.h`, which keeps the SIMD interface controlled through the main header.
